DILG- BAGONG Republic Of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West www.dNq.qov.ph SEP 1 1 2025 OPINION NO. HON. BARTOLOME N. RIVERA, JR. Mayor Municipality of San Mateo Province of Rizal Dear Mayor Rivera, Jr.: This peltains to your letter requesting for the Department's position paper on "whether the Municipal Mayor, without any court order, demolish privately-owned structures blocking unclassified existing road constructed by the DPWH, but which road is located within a private land?" To answer your question, we would like to invite your attention to Executive Order No. 124, dated 30 January 1987 which authorizes the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to classify roads and highways into national, provincial, city and barangay roads. This Department opines that, even if the road is still unclassified but was built by DPWH, it is presumed to be a public infrastructure and part of the public domain unless otherwise reclassified or abandoned. Under Section 444 (b)(3)(vi) the Municipal Mayor should require owners of illegally constructed houses, buildings, or other structures to obtain the necessary perrnit, subject to such fines and penalties as may be imposed by law or ordinance, or to make necessary changes in the construction of the same when said construction violates any law or ordinance, or to order the demolition or removal of said house, building or structure within the period prescribed by law or ordinance. This implies if a structure (a) encroaches upon a public road, (b) lacks building permit and (c) violates zoning ordinances or national laws. The municipal mayor has administrative power to order its removal, following due process. Coordination with the DPWH may be required in order to carry out the removal of the privately-owned structures blocking existing road constructed by the former. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly Thank you. .
